description: Soy ingeniero, apasionado por la física y la programación. Este año elegí el simulador de entrenamiento porque desde que lo leí me emociona mucho las posibilidades que hay en el reto. Quiero enfocarme en el storytelling y arte que hay detrás de un videojuego. Lo considero un reto emocionante en la dinámica de Hackathon, no solo es un reto técnico enorme (tiempo, UX, dinámica del juego), sino artístico (assets, audio) para hacer frente a una industria que están en su punto de mayor crecimiento.
summary:
During a space mission, something went terribly wrong. The Space Crew lost all communications. Choose between two game modes: lead the stranded crew to the rescue point or command the rescue mission to find the lost crew. Manage resources, make strategic decisions, find shelter to withstand the harsh weather, and complete the rescue requirements before it's too late.
We created an artistic open-world game that lets you explore and imagine what it would be like to live on another planet. The concept has two different perspectives. Being stranded on a desert planet with a broken cargo forces the player to look for on-site resources to repair their life support equipment while heading towards the extraction point. On the other hand, rescue involves sending smart search expeditions.
details: Our App is a Web Based Game with zero installation required. We chose a very childlike visual style for our audience, but it’s still appealing to adults. The game has different missions and difficulty levels that let the player focus on fewer aspects while learning at their own pace: from not needing to sleep on the easiest difficulties to having to take care of your crew's mental state on expert levels. The stack beeing used is plain HTML, CSS and JS with open source game dev libraries.
